name: No-Clashing Teaching Dimension of Warmuth's $C_5$ Class
proof: The repository's exact C5 verifier constructs the ten cyclic $1001$ concepts, enumerates every target-consistent labeled sample of size at most one, and exhaustively rejects every no-clashing teacher map of width one. It then returns an explicit no-clashing map of width two. Hence $\mathrm{NCTD}(C_5)=2$.
